description_en: Enables or disables the Intelligent Protection policy for a website
description_zh: 设置网站业务AI智能防护的开关状态
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-ai-protect-switch --domain www.aliyun.com --config AiRuleEnable_:_1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebAIProtectSwitch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for a domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The details of the Intelligent Protection policy. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following fields:

AiRuleEnable: the status of the Intelligent Protection policy. This field is required and must be of the integer type. Valid values:

    *   0: disabled
    *   1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
AI智能防护配置的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
AiRuleEnable：Integer类型，必选，AI智能防护功能的开关状态。取值：
    - 0：关闭
    - 1：开启
parameters.name: config
